parameters.description: Rate of slow motion playback. This value must be greater than one and less than or equal to 100. For example, 1 < dRate <= 100. To achieve slow motion playback, dRate must be some value greater than one. If dRate is set to 2, then the renderer should display each frame for 2 frame periods, which is half-speed playback. If dRate is set to 4, the renderer should display each frame for 4 frame periods, which is one quarter speed playback, and so on.
